# 05d One id scope, for every renderer

## Outcome

No two Siren diagrams on one page share an id, whatever kinds they are. `mintIdScope` is written
once, and the sequence renderer is its third caller rather than the one kind left out.

## Why this ticket exists

Ticket 05c scoped marker ids in the flowchart and class-diagram renderers, and reported honestly
that it could not finish the job: `renderSequenceToSVG.ts` still emits the fixed ids
`siren-arrow-filled`, `siren-arrow-cross` and `siren-arrow-open`. So "no duplicate ids on a page"
is true of two of the three kinds.

The exposure there is the *pre-existing invisible* one rather than the one 05c activated — sequence
markers carry no author color, because author styling for sequence diagrams is a deliberate board
non-goal. It becomes visible the moment two sequence diagrams on a page sit in different CSS
contexts, which ADR-0004 explicitly invites by letting a consumer scope `--siren-*` tokens to a
container: both diagrams define the same id, `url(#...)` resolves to the first, and the second
diagram's arrowheads take the first's themed color.

05c also left `mintIdScope` duplicated on purpose — once per renderer, as peers rather than one
importing the other — and said the third caller is what should trigger lifting it. This is the
third caller.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] `mintIdScope` lives in one module all three renderers import. Neither existing copy remains.
- [x] **Verify the two copies are identical before merging them**, by diff rather than on 05c's
      word. This board has already been reminded twice why: board 2 found three "identical" drain
      loops that were not, and ticket 03b diffed before merging for the same reason. If they
      differ, stop and report it.
- [x] The sequence renderer's three marker ids are scoped per render, and its edges reference its
      own markers.
- [x] A page holding one diagram of **each** kind, plus a second of each, has zero duplicate ids —
      assert across all six, the way 05c asserted across its four.
- [x] The theme still governs every sequence arrowhead. `--siren-*` redeclaration must still reach
      them; nothing about sequence styling changes, and no sequence marker gains an author color.
- [x] Every existing sequence renderer test passes **unedited**, except assertions that name a
      marker id literally — those follow 05c's precedent and find the marker by following the
      reference from the element that uses it, which is how they should have read it anyway. Call
      out any you change.
- [x] The reasoning 05c wrote into `renderToSVG.ts` — why document-scoped ids are the hazard, why a
      random token rather than a counter or a content hash — moves to the shared module rather than
      being summarized. It is the argument for the scheme, and it should live with the scheme.

## Test seam

`render()`, with several diagrams in one document — the only place an id collision is observable.
